help.text:
✦ UPSTAGE CLI SHORTCUTS & COMMANDS
  
  Shortcuts:
  Tab    : Cycle Focus (Input/Chat/Sidebar)
  Ctrl+S : Toggle Session Browser
  Ctrl+T : Toggle Repository Map
  Ctrl+X : Open External Editor
  Ctrl+C : Copy Selected Text
  Ctrl+E : Cycle Solar Pro2 Reasoning Effort (auto/low/high)
  Esc    : Enter Navigation Mode (j/k to scroll) / Clear Selection
  Esc+Esc: Rewind Session (Undo last turn)
  i      : Focus Input (Insert Mode)
  
  Mouse:
  Drag to select text, release to copy — or click sidebar tabs/status bar
  mode chip directly. If a drag ever grabs our UI instead of text, hold
  Option (iTerm2) or Shift (most other terminals) to use the terminal's
  own native selection instead.
  
  Slash Commands:
  /new      : Start a fresh session
  /sessions : Open session browser
  /tree     : Open repository map
  /help     : Show this help message
  /lang ko  : Switch language to Korean
  /lang en  : Switch language to English
  /exit     : Exit the application
